title: Ran se Sheh ki Sada Yeh Aaee Hai
body:
Ran se sheh ki sada yeh aaee hai
Ali akber ne barchi khaee hai
1. Shah ne roker kaha yeh Zainab se
Shaq dil par teri judaee hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Maa ko phupiyoun ko chor beta
Tune basti kaha basaee hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ab na Abbas aur na Qasim hai
Shahe deen par musbat aaee hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hum shabhi e nabi tere gham mein
Gham zada Fatima ki jaaee hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ek lamha na saaye mein baithi
Zest laila ne yun bitaee hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ya Ali kehke dhast mein mazher
Sheh ne laashe jawan uthaee hai
Azz..Mazher Abedi
